description: This Java source file defines the CategoryController class, which is a Spring MVC controller responsible for managing category-related administrative functionalities in an e-commerce application. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, saving, deleting, and moving categories, as well as handling category hierarchy and code validation.

classes.name: CategoryController
classes.description: A Spring MVC Controller responsible for managing product categories in the admin panel, including CRUD operations and hierarchy management.

methods.name: displayCategoryEdit
methods.description: Handles GET requests to edit a category by ID, delegating to displayCategory.

methods.name: displayCategoryCreate
methods.description: Handles GET requests to create a new category, delegating to displayCategory.

methods.name: displayCategory
methods.description: Prepares the model with category data for editing or creating a category, including descriptions and parent categories.

methods.name: saveCategory
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update a category, including validation and lineage adjustments.

methods.name: displayCategories
methods.description: Displays the main categories list page. Actual data is loaded via AJAX.

methods.name: pageCategories
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST requests to fetch a paginated list of categories, optionally filtered by name.

methods.name: displayCategoryHierarchy
methods.description: Displays the hierarchical view of categories.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to delete a category by ID, with authorization checks.

methods.name: moveCategory
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to move a category under a new parent.

methods.name: checkCategoryCode
methods.description: AJAX endpoint to validate the uniqueness of a category code.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the menu context for the admin panel views.
